build_dbscan_clustering: build a DBSCAN clustering model with eps and min_samples parameters to find density-based clusters
create_synthetic_blobs: create synthetic cluster data using make_blobs with configurable centers and sample count
test_clustering_metrics: test clustering quality using homogeneity, completeness, v_measure, adjusted_rand, and silhouette scores
run_clustering_evaluation: run DBSCAN clustering and evaluate with metrics comparing predicted labels to ground truth
plot_cluster_results: plot DBSCAN clustering results with core samples, non-core samples, and noise points color-coded
